svg.text: Bottom view (column a at the top). Only these nets are drawn; everything else is left out.
VBAT: battery + rail (charger LOAD+ output: feeds the ports, D3 -> ESP, battery divider)
BATT+: cell + (battery pin -> charger BATT+ input only)
Underneath: rail j11-j24; bridges i15-j15, h23-i23, i23-j23, b19-c19, c19-d19
Solid = bare rail / bridge; numbered dots = part pins and leads soldered in from the top. Every dot of one color must beep to every other dot of that color, and never to the other color.
